privacy.

1thing has no accounts, shows no ads and doesn't track you. what you write stays on your iPhone. everything is explained in detail below.

updated on 18 November 2026

who we are

the data controller is Oliviero Massaccesi. for any privacy question, write to feedback@1thingapp.com.

what stays on your iPhone

your goals, notes, paintings, the answers to the questions at the start, your name, your companion and your settings. they are saved only on your phone, in a space the app shares with its widgets. we don't see them.

if you've turned on iCloud backup, Apple may include this data in your phone's backup, under its own terms.

suggestions written by artificial intelligence

only if you agree, the app sends our server the answers you gave at the start: the topics you chose, your reasons, your obstacles, how much time you have, what you keep putting off and what you wrote about yourself. with them we send the app's language and a random code that identifies the installation, not you.

we don't send your name, your daily goals or your notes.

the server passes the answers to Claude, Anthropic's artificial intelligence model, which writes the suggestions. the suggestions come back to your phone and stay there: our server doesn't keep them. Anthropic doesn't use data sent through its API to train its models and keeps it only for a limited period, as described in its terms.

this happens once, and again only if you answer the questions again or write something when a painting is finished. the basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time from the studio.

we recommend not writing health information or other sensitive details in your answers.

our server

the server runs on Cloudflare. to prevent abuse it counts how many requests come from each installation (at most 5 every 30 days): to do this it keeps only an encrypted fingerprint of the installation code, not the code itself. we don't log IP addresses or the content of requests.

data outside the European Union

Cloudflare and Anthropic may process data in the United States. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; with Anthropic, the transfer is covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

if you write to us

if you email us, the app adds the app version, your phone model and your iOS version at the bottom of the message, and you can see them before sending. we keep messages for as long as we need to reply.

purchases

in-app purchases are handled by Apple. we don't see your payment details.

notifications

reminders are scheduled on your phone. they don't go through our server.

analytics and advertising

the app doesn't use analytics tools from other companies, shows no ads and doesn't follow you across other apps or websites.

this website

the site uses no cookies and no analytics. it remembers the language you chose in your browser, and the font is hosted with the site. the provider hosting the site may record technical data about visits, such as your IP address, to run and protect it.

your rights

you can ask us to access, correct or delete the data we hold, to restrict its use or to receive a copy, and you can withdraw your consent to the suggestions at any time. write to feedback@1thingapp.com.

you can also complain to the data protection authority of the country where you live.

children

if you're under 16, ask a parent before turning on the suggestions written by artificial intelligence.

changes

if we change this policy, we update the date at the top. if something important changes, we tell you in the app.
